mapper.select: select * from eng_user_word_progress where user_id=#{userId} and word_id=#{wordId} for update
select * from eng_user_word_progress where user_id=#{userId} and word_id=#{wordId}
mapper.update: update eng_user_word_progress set learned=#{learned},highest_stars=#{highestStars},latest_stars=#{latestStars}, latest_test_time=#{latestTestTime},rewarded_stars=#{rewardedStars}, first_article_id=coalesce(first_article_id,#{firstArticleId}),first_level_no=coalesce(first_level_no,#{firstLevelNo}), update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select word_id from eng_user_word_progress where user_id=#{userId} and learned=1 and word_id in #{wordId}

select p.word_id,w.word_name,w.acceptation,p.highest_stars,p.latest_stars,p.latest_test_time, group_concat(distinct a.title order by a.id separator ',') source_article_names from eng_user_word_progress p join eng_word w on w.id=p.word_id left join eng_article_word_rel r on r.word_name=w.word_name and r.article_id>0 left join eng_article a on a.id=r.article_id and a.create_by=p.create_by where p.user_id=#{userId} and p.learned=1 group by p.id,w.id order by p.id
select count(*) from eng_user_word_progress where user_id=#{userId} and learned=1
